_comment: ATS v8 resource.json — copy to input/resource.json and fill in your app's details.

auth._comment_types: Supported types: none | form_login | bearer_token | api_key
auth._comment_form_login: Optional: explicit login URL. If omitted, ATS infers from routes.
auth._comment_bearer: For bearer_token type: POST endpoint that returns {access_token: ...}
auth._comment_api_key: For api_key type: injected as X-API-Key header

_comment_skip: Routes to exclude from crawling and test generation. Supports * prefix wildcards.
_comment_extra: Optional: additional Playwright extra_http_headers injected into every request.
_comment_features: Optional: override which feature areas to focus on. If omitted, inferred by ATS.
